description: Company default-risk score (0-100) for a French company at ~12 months: credit risk and insolvency risk scoring from filed financial ratios (structure, profitability, liquidity, net cash, debt service, trend) + company age + a hard BODACC override (active insolvency / liquidation / closure for insufficiency of assets = proven default). Returns score, qualitative band, every component with its threshold, and a confidence level. Decision-support only, NOT a solvency opinion or credit rating. Statistical indicator about the company, not a decision or an assessment about a person. `couverture_axes` names the axes the scale could evaluate and the silent ones with a closed-list reason (no published ratio, holding lens, single-year trend, uncovered line items, commercial-court decisions not read): a silent axis cannot penalise, so fewer computed axes means possibly understated risk, never a better score. Commercial-court decisions linked to the company are counted in `contentieux_informatif` (by nature and role, partial coverage: zero never means no litigation; `dernier_passage_complet` dates the collection's last full pass). One measured cell weighs (since scale version defaillance-v1.10, measured against a placebo): at least one order or judgment to pay as defendant dated within the twelve months before the day of computation adds 12 points for an SME (PME) only, never for a mid-cap, a large company or an unknown category (`contentieux_informatif.cellule`: count, points, closed-list reason); other decisions do not weigh. `echelle.backtest` carries the dated measurement of the scale on real French defaults (BODACC opening judgments from 31 December 2025 to 3 September 2026 joined with filed accounts, case-control design): AUC, share of defaults per band with confidence intervals, detection at the 25 and 50 thresholds. These are OBSERVED rates on a sample, never a probability of default for the company you are reading; `versions_couvertes` names the scale versions the measurement holds for. Fully disclosed legal persons only: a sole proprietorship, a restricted-diffusion unit or a group without legal personality is refused, 400 with the exact code, never charged. Paid via x402 ($0.10 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.
